subject: Next steps: legal -> security -> finance timeline & PO vs card
messages:
From: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@medsys.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medsys.io
Date: 2026-08-17T17:15:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up from today's discovery - procurement path and timeline

Hi Vanessa / Ben,

Thanks for the call today — that was helpful. A few procurement questions popped up on our side and I wanted to capture them so we can align on a concrete timeline: 

- Our procurement team prefers PO-based purchases for production contracts, though Finance will allow a card payment for pilot engagements under $5k. Can you confirm whether Redwood supports both (PO + card) and if there are any constraints on pilot billing?
- Legal will need a copy of SOC 2 and proposed contract terms to start review. What turnaround should we expect?
- Security has a short questionnaire; do you have a completed template we can use or a link to an online form?
- For timing, can we get a draft SOW/order form this week so Finance can start paperwork?

If you can map the typical milestone flow you see (legal -> security -> finance -> PO issuance) with owners and target windows, that would help us plan internal gating.

Thanks — happy to set a quick procurement sync later this week if useful.

Best,
Elena Cruz
Head of Procurement
MediSys Health
[Attachment: MediSys_Procurement_Template.pdf (pdf)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@medsys.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's discovery - procurement path and timeline

Hi Elena — great to meet today. Recap + proposed mutual action plan below. I put Ben and Karthik on cc to own commercial and legal/security respectively.

Quick answers up front: Redwood supports both PO and card. Card is typically used for pilots <$5k; for committed/prod contracts we expect a PO. We can also list Redwood on customer marketplaces but you said during the call you preferred direct PO for speed — we can follow that.

Proposed milestones (high level):
- Draft Order Form / SOW shared (Owner: Vanessa) — Target: 2026-08-20
- Legal initial review (Owner: MediSys Legal + Redwood Legal (Karthik)) — Target window: 2 weeks from SOW delivery
- Security questionnaire + SOC2 submission (Owner: MediSys Security + Redwood Security (Karthik)) — Target: 1 week for questionnaire; SOC2 attached during review
- Finance PO issuance (Owner: MediSys Finance) — Target: 1 week after legal signoff (or shorter if card pilot)
- Provisioning & Kickoff (Owner: Redwood CS) — Target: 3 business days after PO is received

Attachments included: draft SOW (SOW_Redwood_MediSys_v1.pdf), sample invoice template (Invoice_Template_Redwood.xlsx), SOC2 stub (SOC2_Redwood_2026.pdf). Links: HubSpot deal and Drive folder below.

Immediate asks for MediSys: please confirm
1) Will MediSys route via PO for production? (Yes/No)
2) Are there any required contract clauses (data residency, DPA, indemnity caps) to flag early?
3) Who should receive the SOW for legal intake (name + email)?

Next steps: Vanessa to upload SOW + order form to Drive and send DocuSign link for signature after legal redlines are resolved. Suggest procurement sync Fri 8/20 if that works for your team.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Commercial
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW_Redwood_MediSys_v1.pdf (pdf), Invoice_Template_Redwood.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2_Redwood_2026.pdf (pdf)]

From: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@medsys.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Harper <tom.harper@medsys.io>, procurement@medsys.io
Date: 2026-08-19T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's discovery - procurement path and timeline

Vanessa — thanks for the clear plan. A few clarifications from our side after running the outline by Legal and Finance: 

- Legal: SOC2 is required. They will run a contract redline; ideal turnaround for us is ~2 weeks but they may request an extra week depending on vendor backlog. Please include a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) or confirm you will sign ours.
- Security: we prefer a completed questionnaire (we can send our template) but will accept a set of artifacts (SOC2, encryption at rest/in transit, access controls).
- Finance: For a pilot, card is fine if the total invoice is <$5k. For pilot-to-prod path we will issue a PO. We will need an example invoice with Redwood's billing details and a standard PO flow timeline (steps + estimated durations).

I attached our procurement intake template. Can you return a version of the SOW with Redwood billing and legal contacts filled in?

One more ask — if Redwood can commit to a 2-week legal turnaround (from SOW delivery) we can prioritize this and aim to have a PO in hand by ~2026-09-03. Is that realistic?

Thanks — Elena
[Attachment: MediSys_Procurement_Template.pdf (pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@medsys.io>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-20T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's discovery - procurement path and timeline

Elena — thanks for the detail and the template. Quick runbook below to align expectations and responsibilities.

What Redwood will provide immediately:
- Completed security questionnaire (we will start filling your template on receipt)
- SOC2 report (attached: SOC2_Redwood_2026.pdf)
- Draft SOW updated with billing information and Redwood legal contact (attached: SOW_Redwood_MediSys_v1.pdf)
- Sample invoice (attached: Invoice_Template_Redwood.xlsx)

Proposed target timeline (contingent on MediSys legal intake queue):
- Day 0 (SOW delivery): Redwood provides SOW + SOC2 + invoice template + filled security questionnaire (if you share your template)
- Legal review: target 10 business days for initial redlines (we can compress to 7 business days if needed but need a narrow set of redlines)
- Security review: 5 business days after questionnaire submission
- Finance PO issuance: 3 business days after legal signoff (or immediate card payment for pilot)
- Provisioning: 3 business days after PO or payment

Owners and escalation points:
- Redwood legal: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
- Redwood commercial: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
- Redwood CS (provisioning): Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Attachments: SOC2_Redwood_2026.pdf, Invoice_Template_Redwood.xlsx, SOW_Redwood_MediSys_v1.pdf

If MediSys can commit to a 10-business-day initial legal review window we can realistically hit a PO by 2026-09-03 as Vanessa proposed. If you need the 7 business day path, highlight a short list of must-have contract clauses and we'll prioritize quick review.

I'll also propose a 30-minute legal Q&A with our counsel early next week to speed alignment. Vanessa — can you propose 3 time slots?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2_Redwood_2026.pdf (pdf), Invoice_Template_Redwood.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW_Redwood_MediSys_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@medsys.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Harper <tom.harper@medsys.io>, procurement@medsys.io
Date: 2026-08-25T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's discovery - procurement path and timeline

Thanks Karthik / Vanessa — this is helpful and aligns with our internal plan. Quick confirmations: 

- MediSys will route production via PO. Pilot will go on card if under $5k.
- We will share our security questionnaire (expect by EOD 8/25). Please confirm you will populate and return within 5 business days.
- Legal Q&A: Monday 2026-08-30, 10:00am PT works for our counsel. Please send calendar invite.
- We will prioritize legal intake to try to hit the 10-business-day window; procurement will aim to issue PO ~2026-09-03 if legal clears on that cadence.

Please send the updated SOW with billing/legal contact by tomorrow so we can kick Finance intake. Also please share the invoice with Redwood's remittance address filled in.

Looking forward — Elena
Elena Cruz
Head of Procurement
MediSys Health
[Attachment: MediSys_Procurement_Template.pdf (pdf)]
